action_items: Fix Professionals.jsx openEdit: merge each day of working_hours with a default {open:'09:00', close:'18:00', closed:false} so partial DB values don't crash the edit dialog. Suggested: `working_hours: DOW.reduce((acc,d)=>({...acc,[d.key]: {...emptyForm.working_hours[d.key], ...(p.working_hours?.[d.key]||{})}}),{})`.

Consider adding server-side idempotent seed for manager/pro/client passwords or a rate-limit on /api/auth/login; during testing this env had its manager password rotated by another agent, requiring direct DB reset.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _wa_phone normalizes only when len(phone)<=11 without existing 55 prefix; if a manager enters a phone starting with '0' (leading zero for area code) or 12+ digits without 55, it won't be normalized. Consider tightening the rule (e.g., always drop leading 0, always ensure 55 prefix for BR numbers).
appointment_whatsapp endpoint uses request query param `origin` for building the studio link but doesn't validate/normalize it. Low risk but worth sanitizing.
Professionals.jsx uses spread `...p` after `...emptyForm` — non-day sub-keys are covered, but partial working_hours dict is not merged deeply. Root cause of the HIGH bug above.

Ana's working_hours missing keys makes /profissionais edit crash — reproduce by clicking edit-pro-<Ana_id>.
rca of the issue: Professionals.jsx line 34: `working_hours: p.working_hours && Object.keys(p.working_hours).length ? p.working_hours : emptyForm.working_hours`. When p.working_hours has SOME keys (e.g. mon..fri) but not all 7 days, the fallback isn't used and DOW.map hits `form.working_hours['sat']` = undefined, then reads `.closed` → crash. Fix: deep-merge per day with emptyForm defaults.
